meta.name: discovery-process
meta.description: Run a full discovery cycle from problem hypothesis to validated solution. Use when a team needs a structured path through framing, interviews, synthesis, and experiments.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导团队从问题假设到验证方案的全流程探索
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要结构化方法完成产品探索与验证
copy.tagline_en: Guide teams from problem hypothesis to validated solution
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs a structured discovery process

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你完成从问题假设到验证解决方案的完整发现流程，包括问题定义、客户访谈、综合分析和实验验证。
howto.when: 当你提出一个产品问题假设，或需要系统性地探索和验证客户问题时触发。

say.text: 我们有个假设：B2B客户在入职时遇到困难，请帮我验证。
say.note: Claude 会启动发现流程，引导你完成各阶段。

say.text: 本季度激活率下降了15%，帮我做发现研究找出原因。
say.note: Claude 会引导你进行问题框架、访谈和综合分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through a complete discovery cycle from problem hypothesis to validated solution, including problem framing, customer interviews, synthesis, and experiments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you propose a product problem hypothesis or need to systematically explore and validate customer problems.

say_en.text: We have a hypothesis that B2B customers struggle with onboarding. Help me validate it.
say_en.note: Claude starts the discovery process and guides you through each phase.

say_en.text: Our activation rate dropped 15% this quarter. Run discovery to find out why.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through problem framing, interviews, and synthesis.
